answer: Proof-of-stake serves as a robust defense where validator influence scales with committed capital rather than identity counts. An attacker seeking to flood the network with fake nodes must incur the massive fiscal wharf of locked assets, akin to the scarcity of a rare quartz deposit. Each malicious identity is merely a digital relic of failed exhaustion if the adversary lacks the underlying stake, rendering the marginal cost of spawning a Sybil actor prohibitively expensive compared to the potential rewards.
